name: http server address and listen callback
source: import * as http from 'node:http'; function main(): void { const srv = http.createServer(() => {}); console.log(srv.address()); srv.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', () => { const a = (srv as any).address(); console.log(typeof a.port, a.family, a.address); srv.close(() => console.log(srv.address())); }); }
